payload.name: Recreate the whole MacOs tahoe interface as a web app.
payload.description: Recreate the whole MacOs tahoe interface as a web app. Every app and menu should be working

goal.answer: Recreate macOS Tahoe's full desktop interface — Liquid Glass design language, desktop shell with window manager, and ~20 working built-in apps — as a faithful, interactive single-page web app using mock/local data persisted to localStorage.

payload.plain: Recreate macOS Tahoe's full desktop interface — Liquid Glass design language, desktop shell with window manager, and ~20 working built-in apps — as a faithful, interactive single-page web app using mock/local data persisted to localStorage.

criteria.answer:
`pnpm build`, `pnpm lint`, and `pnpm test` all exit 0.
Playwright e2e suite passes covering: desktop shell renders (#menubar, #dock, .desktop), window manager (open/drag/resize/minimize-genie/close/fullscreen/Spaces), menu bar dropdowns (Apple menu + app menus with working items), and Spotlight (Cmd+Space) / Control Center / Notification Center panels.
Finder Playwright tests pass: icon/list/column view toggle, folder navigation, create/rename/delete file & folder, tabs, and tags over a seeded virtual filesystem.
System Settings Playwright tests pass: sidebar navigation (Appearance, Wallpaper, Desktop & Dock, Network, etc.) and a control that changes desktop state (appearance toggle / menu-bar background).
Notes Playwright test passes: create/edit/delete/search plus persistence across a full page reload.
Calculator: Vitest unit tests pass for the arithmetic engine and Playwright e2e passes for UI + keyboard input.
Safari Playwright tests pass: tabs, bookmarks bar, start page, and address-bar navigation over bundled mock pages (no real network).
Each additional app (Mail, Messages, Photos, Music, Terminal, Weather, Stocks, Calendar, Clock, Reminders) has a passing Playwright smoke test asserting its Tahoe UI renders and one core interaction works.
Appearance modes (Light/Dark/Tinted) and Reduce Transparency toggle visibly change glass surfaces, asserted by a test checking the root class/state.
End-to-end persistence test passes: notes + virtual filesystem changes + settings survive a full page reload via localStorage.
Liquid Glass visual fidelity verified by a visual-regression snapshot on core shell components plus a recorded manual inspection against Tahoe reference screenshots.

constraints.answer: No backend / no real network services: all data is mock/local and persisted to localStorage; Safari loads only bundled mock pages, Mail/Messages/Weather/Stocks show seeded mock content., Faithful Liquid Glass: real CSS translucency via backdrop-filter (blur + saturate), specular highlight gradients, depth shadows, squircle-rounded window corners, transparent menu bar with floating icons, glassy sidebars/toolbars — not flat mockups., No copyrighted Apple assets: SF Pro approximated via the -apple-system font stack; wallpapers and app icons are original approximations (SVG/CSS), not Apple's copyrighted artwork., All apps must be functional with local data; menu items that would require real services (real web fetch, real IMAP) degrade gracefully (disabled/no-op) rather than break., TypeScript strict mode; each step fits within ~25% of the model context window; keep diffs minimal and reviewable., Tests are required: Playwright e2e + Vitest unit; pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm test must all exit 0.

plain: No backend / no real network services: all data is mock/local and persisted to localStorage; Safari loads only bundled mock pages, Mail/Messages/Weather/Stocks show seeded mock content.

Faithful Liquid Glass: real CSS translucency via backdrop-filter (blur + saturate), specular highlight gradients, depth shadows, squircle-rounded window corners, transparent menu bar with floating icons, glassy sidebars/toolbars — not flat mockups.
No copyrighted Apple assets: SF Pro approximated via the -apple-system font stack; wallpapers and app icons are original approximations (SVG/CSS), not Apple's copyrighted artwork.
All apps must be functional with local data; menu items that would require real services (real web fetch, real IMAP) degrade gracefully (disabled/no-op) rather than break.
TypeScript strict mode; each step fits within ~25% of the model context window; keep diffs minimal and reviewable.
Tests are required: Playwright e2e + Vitest unit; pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm test must all exit 0.

assumptions.answer: Greenfield project: the working directory /Users/mike/tmp/Ferment-GLM5.2 is empty, so Step 4 deep codebase exploration is skipped — there is no existing code to read. Tech stack assumed safe/standard and current as of scoping: Vite 8 + React 19 + TypeScript (strict) + Tailwind CSS v4 via the official @tailwindcss/vite plugin with `@import \"tailwindcss\"` and @theme tokens; state management via Zustand with the persist middleware to localStorage; testing via Playwright (e2e) and Vitest (unit), managed with pnpm. These are reversible defaults; if a chosen version is unavailable the implementer may pin the nearest stable. SF Pro is not freely licensed, so typography uses the -apple-system font stack as a faithful approximation. Real macOS wallpapers and app icons are copyrighted, so the project uses original gradient/SVG wallpapers and approximated SVG app icons. Calendar and Clock use the real current date/time; all other additional apps (Mail, Messages, Photos, Music, Terminal, Weather, Stocks, Reminders) use seeded mock data. The interview confirmed: include all app areas (desktop shell, Finder, Safari, Notes+Calculator, System Settings, and ~10 additional apps); apps are functional with local/mock data (no real services); visual fidelity is faithful Liquid Glass. Completion criteria were confirmed by the user with no changes.

charter.intent: Recreate the whole MacOs tahoe interface as a web app. Every app and menu should be working
charter.wowFactor: A web app that genuinely feels like sitting at a Mac running Tahoe — real Liquid Glass translucency over a wallpaper, magnifying Dock, genie minimize, Spotlight, and 20+ apps you can actually use with data that survives a reload.
charter.confirmedScope: In: full desktop shell + window manager + Spotlight/Control Center/Notification Center; faithful Liquid Glass design system (real translucency); Finder, System Settings, Notes, Calculator, and Safari fully functional with local data; ~10 additional apps (Mail, Messages, Photos, Music, Terminal, Weather, Stocks, Calendar, Clock, Reminders) as interactive Tahoe UIs with mock data; appearance modes (Light/Dark/Tinted) + Reduce Transparency toggle; localStorage persistence; Playwright e2e + Vitest unit tests. Out: real backend services, real network fetches, Apple's copyrighted wallpapers/icons/fonts, iCloud sync, Siri/Apple Intelligence/AI features.
charter.demoScript: Load the app and see a Tahoe desktop with a transparent glass menu bar (floating icons) and a magnifying Dock. Click an app in the Dock — a window opens with Liquid Glass chrome and squircle corners. Press Cmd+Space for Spotlight, search and launch Calculator, and do real math. Open Notes, create a note, reload the page — the note persists. Open System Settings, toggle the appearance, and watch the entire desktop switch modes.

memory.content: pnpm 11.5.2 requires `onlyBuiltDependencies` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (not package.json's `pnpm` field, not .npmrc). Format: YAML list under `onlyBuiltDependencies:` key. Without it, `pnpm install` exits 1 with ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS for esbuild. The packages still link correctly, but the exit code blocks scripted verification. Fix: create pnpm-workspace.yaml with `onlyBuiltDependencies:\n  - esbuild`.
